criteria.name: Irreversible End-Stage Liver Disease or Localized HCC
criteria.description: Diagnosis of irreversible end-stage liver disease (ESLD) or localized hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) where patient is not a candidate for subtotal liver resection.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm diagnosis of ESLD or non-resectable localized HCC
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: adult liver transplantation when performed on beneficiaries with end- stage liver disease other than hepatitis B or malignancies

criteria.name: Absence of Extrahepatic Metastases or Macrovascular Invasion
criteria.description: For HCC candidates, radiographic confirmation of absence of extrahepatic metastases and absence of macrovascular tumor invasion into major vessels.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude extrahepatic metastatic spread and vascular invasion
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
